metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from February 2, 2019 to May 14, 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Geometry: Polygon around Menindee Lakes, NSW, Australia.
- Dates: Feb 2, 2019 and May 14, 2021. Primary window ±15 days; fallback ±30 days.
- Collections: Prefer COPERNICUS/S2_SR. Fallback to LANDSAT/LC08+C09 L2 SR.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Sentinel-2: Mask SCL classes for cloud/shadow/cirrus/snow (3,8,9,10,11).
- Landsat 8/9: Mask QA_PIXEL cloud and cloud shadow; apply SR scaling.
- Compute mNDWI = (Green - SWIR1)/(Green + SWIR1); water = mNDWI > 0.15.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after all attempts → C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 → C2.
- If reduceRegion returns null/NaN → C3.
- Otherwise compare water area at scale 1000 m; if 2021 < 2019 (beyond small-noise threshold) → A; else → B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
  const scale = 1000;

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[142.20, -32.10],
     [143.00, -32.10],
     [143.00, -32.95],
     [142.20, -32.95],
     [142.20, -32.10]]
  ]);

  const dates = [
    {label: 'D1', date: '2019-02-02'},
    {label: 'D2', date: '2021-05-14'}
  ];

  // 2. Masking & Collections
  function maskS2sr(img) {
    const scl = img.select('SCL');
    const valid = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)).and(scl.neq(11));
    return img.updateMask(valid);
  }
  function maskLandsat(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    const mask = cloud.not().and(cloudShadow.not());
    // Scale reflectance
    const scaleF = 0.0000275;
    const offsetF = -0.2;
    const bands = img.select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).multiply(scaleF).add(offsetF);
    return bands.updateMask(mask);
  }

  function s2Col(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
      .map(maskS2sr)
      .select(['B3', 'B11']); // Green, SWIR1
  }
  function lsCol(start, end) {
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');
    return l8.merge(l9)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .map(maskLandsat)
      .select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']); // Green, SWIR1
  }

  function computeMNDWI(img, sensor) {
    const green = sensor === 'S2' ? img.select('B3') : img.select('SR_B3');
    const swir1 = sensor === 'S2' ? img.select('B11') : img.select('SR_B6');
    const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('mndwi');
    const water = mndwi.gt(0.15).rename('water').updateMask(mndwi.mask());
    return {mndwi, water};
  }

  async function pickSource(dateStr) {
    const base = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const windows = [15, 30];
    // Try Sentinel-2
    for (let w of windows) {
      const start = base.advance(-w, 'day');
      const end = base.advance(w, 'day');
      const col = s2Col(start, end);
      const n = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (n > 0) return {sensor: 'S2', windowDays: w, size: n};
    }
    // Try Landsat
    for (let w of windows) {
      const start = base.advance(-w, 'day');
      const end = base.advance(w, 'day');
      const col = lsCol(start, end);
      const n = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (n > 0) return {sensor: 'Landsat', windowDays: w, size: n};
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function analyzeDate(dateStr, label) {
    const pick = await pickSource(dateStr);
    if (!pick) {
      console.log(`${label} ${dateStr}: No images in ±30d window.`);
      return {status: 'C1'};
    }
    const base = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const start = base.advance(-pick.windowDays, 'day');
    const end = base.advance(pick.windowDays, 'day');
    const col = (pick.sensor === 'S2') ? s2Col(start, end) : lsCol(start, end);
    const mosaic = col.median();
    const {mndwi, water} = computeMNDWI(mosaic, pick.sensor);

    const totalImg = ee.Image(1).rename('one');
    const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('area').updateMask(water);

    const stats = ee.Dictionary({
      validCount: mndwi.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('mndwi'),
      totalCount: totalImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('one'),
      waterAreaM2: areaImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area')
    });

    const s = await getInfo(stats);
    const valid = s.validCount;
    const total = s.totalCount;
    const areaM2 = s.waterAreaM2;

    if (valid === null || total === null || areaM2 === null) {
      console.log(`${label} ${dateStr}: Calculation failed (null statistic).`);
      return {status: 'C3'};
    }
    if (valid === 0) {
      console.log(`${label} ${dateStr}: 0 valid pixels after masking.`);
      return {status: 'C2'};
    }

    const cloudPct = total > 0 ? (100 * (1 - valid / total)) : null;
    const areaKm2 = areaM2 / 1e6;

    console.log(`${label} ${dateStr}: ${pick.sensor} imgs=${pick.size} (±${pick.windowDays}d)`);
    console.log(`${label} Valid px: ${valid}/${total} (cloud/invalid: ${cloudPct !== null ? cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%)`);
    console.log(`${label} Water area: ${areaKm2.toFixed(2)} km²`);

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      areaKm2: areaKm2,
      sensor: pick.sensor,
      imgs: pick.size,
      windowDays: pick.windowDays,
      valid: valid,
      total: total,
      cloudPct: cloudPct
    };
  }

  try {
    const r1 = await analyzeDate(dates[0].date, dates[0].label);
    const r2 = await analyzeDate(dates[1].date, dates[1].label);

    // Handle error conditions
    const errorPriority = ['C1', 'C2', 'C3'];
    for (let code of errorPriority) {
      if (r1.status === code || r2.status === code) {
        console.log(code);
        return;
      }
    }

    // Both OK: Compare areas
    const a1 = r1.areaKm2;
    const a2 = r2.areaKm2;
    if (!isFinite(a1) || !isFinite(a2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const diff = a2 - a1;
    const pct = a1 > 0 ? (diff / a1) * 100.0 : null;
    console.log(`Δ area (2021-2019): ${diff.toFixed(2)} km² (${pct !== null ? pct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%)`);

    // Decision with small-noise threshold
    const threshold = Math.max(0.02 * a1, 2.0); // 2% or 2 km²
    const shrank = (a2 + 1e-6) < (a1 - threshold);
    console.log(shrank ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
